blocks.text: Harbor & Oak SEO 90-day notes, March 12

This is the working cut for HBR-MTG-2021-033 on March 12, 2021. Nia Brooks asked for a written bound after the current path (Search Console on seo.harbor.internal, 14 collections, 412 SKUs) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host seo.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on city name in every product title, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Title pattern: product, then brand, then Harbor & Oak. Collection index for 14 collections. Local pack work is Nia's, not a theme rewrite. I am not restating a hallway yes. city name in every product title is out because That pattern cannibalized 22 product URLs against the Bloomington collection. Nia showed the Search Console pile on the call. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at days=90, vis=38.6, cannibal=22, collections=14, skus=412, clicks=1.9, pos=12.4, weeks=13. Sibling tickets HBR-2210 and HBR-2210-COPY. I will not reopen city name in every product title in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
